svg.title: Adelpha: local-first MRI engineering platform
svg.text: Desktop integration of scanner engineering, digital-twin telemetry, MRI acquisition, and optional AI-assisted workflows.
Native windows · paths · PTY · Python sidecar lifecycle
CAD assembly, inspection, and simulation part
Exam queue, protocol editing, sequence control, and
Shared scanner context, settings, and persisted workspace layout
Twin and MRI APIs are mounted locally; the optional Agents service is reverse-proxied.
Scanner hardware, sensors, and model provider
API, application programming interface; EMI, electromagnetic interference; RF, radio frequency.

Adelpha software architecture. The Tauri desktop shell hosts three React workspaces and manages an authenticated Python sidecar. Local APIs connect digital-twin services, MRI acquisition hardware, and optional agent-based model services.
